caption: The drawing shows a detailed depiction of a teapot, rendered in shades of black, gray, and white. The teapot is positioned in profile view, with the spout extending to the left and the handle to the right. The body of the teapot is rounded and bulbous, with subtle vertical contour lines to indicate curvature and volume. The lid is domed with a finial at the top. The spout is long and curves smoothly outward and upward. The handle is angular, forming a sharp right angle at the top, and is shaded darker than the body, possibly indicating a different material or a different finish. The base of the teapot is slightly flared. The artist’s signature “G. Capelli” appears in the lower right corner within the border framing the drawing. The artwork is executed on a cream-colored background, with the entire composition enclosed by a rectangular pen or pencil border.
title: Silver Teapot
